articles.summary: ATLANTA, Dec. 10, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Atlanticus Holdings Corporation (NASDAQ: ATLC) (Atlanticus, the Company, we, our or us), a financial technology company that enables its bank, retail and healthcare partners to offer more inclusive financial services to millions of everyday Americans, today announced that on December 4, 2025, the Mercury subsidiaries of Atlanticus refinanced an existing $750 million term securitization.
